Governance roadmap

Governance starts with timelocks and grows into earned community control.

PHN governance is intentionally phased. The current priority is secure launch execution through LaunchTimelock controls. The future target is SKYGOV: a non-transferable governance credential earned by verified node operators, stakers, contributors, and game participants.

Today: Timelock Controls

Privileged protocol actions route through LaunchTimelock so core parameters cannot be changed instantly from a hot wallet.

Next: Governance Staking

PHN staking becomes the first participation signal for voting eligibility, proposal access, and contributor reputation.

Future: SKYGOV

SKYGOV is planned as a soulbound governance credential. It is earned through real contribution, not bought from a market.

Scope of Votes

Expected voting scope includes treasury direction, validator criteria, game mechanics, exchange listings, grants, and chain upgrade priorities.

Governance Principles

  • Security first: no instant privileged changes.
  • Humans over bots: governance weight comes from verified participation.
  • Utility over speculation: governance tokens should steer systems, not become another hype asset.
  • Phased decentralization: Skymetric Consulting LLP executes launch, then progressively hands control to proven contributors.
